proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y a b mx my Vx Vy hs hy hmx hmy hVx hVy
  have hn : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hS : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * mx := by
    rw [hmx]
    field_simp
  have hmy' : my = a * mx + b := by
    rw [hmy, Finset.sum_congr rfl hy, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hS]
    field_simp
  have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hy i hi, hmy']
    ring
  rw [hVy, hVx, h]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y : ι → ℝ) (a b mx my Vx Vy : ℝ), s.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ s, y i = a * x i + b) → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → Vx = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = (∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = a ^ 2 * Vx
